decision.reason: [ev-91fac6720d6f] says only that the deprecated flag `install-egress-gateway-routes` has been removed. It does not say what happens when an environment still sets it: the value could be silently ignored, or the agent could fail to start because of an unknown flag. So the setting-ignored kind (and the high severity) is not supported by the evidence. To decide the consequence, we need evidence such as agent or flag-parsing behaviour for removed flags, or upgrade-guide text describing the effect.
